raw_response:
My name don't matter. I been farming this 7.5 mu since I married in. My man and me, we do what we always do. No school teach me this — my mother-in-law teach me, and I watch the neighbors.

I plant wheat in October after we take off the corn. Then next June I cut wheat and plant corn same day, quick quick. Everyone in our village do this way.

For seed — I buy what the dealer in town got. For corn I use that Zhengdan 958, my neighbor Wang get good harvest with it for many years so I use same. For wheat I use Jimai, whatever they selling. The old seed my grandfather used, nobody plant that no more, too small harvest.

Fertilizer — this is where the money go. I buy the compound fertilizer, the one with three numbers on the bag, 15-15-15. I put 2 bags per mu when I plow — that's about 100 jin, 50 kilo. Then when wheat turn green in spring I spread 1 bag of urea per mu, maybe little more. Corn same — I put compound when I plant, then urea when the corn knee-high. If I put too little, the leaves turn yellow and I lose harvest. Better waste a little money than have empty field. My neighbor Liu, he try to save money one year, use less fertilizer — his corn was short, he cry about it.

Water — I got the well, thank heaven. Wheat I water maybe 3 times: before winter so it don't freeze dry, then when it turn green, then when the head come out. Corn if rain come good I water 1 time, if dry summer I water 2 times.

Spray — I spray when I see bugs or the wheat get that rust spot. Maybe 2 times each crop, sometimes 3 if bad year. My son bring the sprayer, he help.

Plowing — we rent the small tractor from village, rotary blade, it chop up the corn stalks and mix in. Faster than old way.

Harvest — good year I get 900 jin wheat per mu, 1100 jin corn per mu. Bad year less. I hope this year be good year.
